QuestInfo.name: Hero On The Scene
QuestInfo.0: You followed the clues #b#p1531007##k gave you, and found a student all shaken up. Now that you've calmed them, ask what happened.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: The student asked you to save a friend inside the classroom. Defeat the strange monsters and save the student.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: What you fought inside was not a creature or machine, but something far more mysterious. Is there a way to find out what it is?\r\n

0.0: I'm okay now, but my friend isn't. I-I hear strange sounds... It's s-scary and I c-can't go in. Please, go in and save my friend!\r\n
0.1: There's something strange inside. Honest! I can't see it, but I hear it. I-I can't bring myself to even move... please help. \r\n

yes.0: W-will you be okay? T-there's something strange inside. B-be careful.

no.0: B-But I can't just leave. My friend... What do I do?

1.msg: Hey, pull yourself together! Your friend is outside, you both should make a break for it.

mob.0: It's all a dream... It's all a dream... \r\n#b(The student can't think straight because of the monsters. Defeat them and talk to the student again.)#k
